title: The record pill wording for a work order, part sale and line
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Notifications page opens from the bell icon at the top right, next to your location name.
  2. Open the Notifications page from the bell icon at the top right (it opens on the Inbox tab).
  3. Seed notifications from a note on a work order (e.g. S2-4219), a part sale (e.g. P9667-370), and a work order line: on a QA branch the second user is the Tech quick-login user (sign in from a private browser window with the Tech button; appears as "Tech ShopView"); it writes each note (Notes tab -> New Note; for the line, pick it under "Create note for"), types @ and picks "Admin ShopView", then clicks Save.
custom_steps:
1. On the Notifications page (click the bell icon at the top right; it opens on the Inbox tab), read the reference pill on the work-order notification.
  2. Read it on the part-sale notification.
  3. Read it on the work-order-line notification.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A work order pill reads "Work Order: S<shop>-<number>" (e.g. "Work Order: S99-15591").
  • A part sale pill reads "Part Sale: P<shop>-<number>" (e.g. "Part Sale: P99-4021").
  • A work order line pill reads "Line: " followed by the work order number, the line's position, its name and its description.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667; story SV-10245 (S2, Read a notification); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297), S2; design board InboxAfter; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R5: “For a work order, the reference pill reads "Work Order: S<shop>-<number>" (for example, "Work Order: S99-15591").”
  • S2-R6: “For a part sale, the reference pill reads "Part Sale: P<shop>-<number>" (for example, "Part Sale: P99-4021").”
  • S2-R7: “For a work order line, the reference pill reads "Line: " followed by the work order number, the line's position, its name and its description.”

Last checked against build v26.40.7-7ffda69 on 10/5/2026.
